written.description: Wraps the NetExec CLI as a subprocess and nothing more, across every protocol it speaks. Discovery meta-tools keep its 128 calls out of the model's context until it asks for them.

alive.last_commit_message:
docs(readme): list every env var, keep the agent's NetExec apart, use uv --no-sync

Configure now lists the 13 environment variables in one table; the
Reference copy, which was incomplete, is gone. A new section explains
how to keep the agent's NetExec home apart from the operator's: one
NXC_PATH per engagement, created beforehand and given as a full path,
since nxc neither expands ~ nor creates a missing parent and the
server then refuses to start; NXC_WORKSPACE does not separate
engagements, nxc keeps writing to the workspace in its nxc.conf.

Every client example sets NXC_PATH, and the health check names
nxc_home. The uv examples and .mcp.json.example run the server with
`uv run --no-sync` (run `uv sync` after each pull); the example no
longer uses ~ in NXC_PATH, which made nxc crash at startup.
